variants.name: PH Daily Forecast
variants.tagline: Tomorrow's Product Hunt top 5, predicted at 12:05am
variants.description: A free public board that predicts each day's Product Hunt leaderboard five minutes after launches go live. Back-tested on 184 days: on average 3.3 of our top-5 picks finished in the real top 5. Every prediction is scored in public the next day.

variants.name: PH Daily Forecast
variants.tagline: A public scoreboard for Product Hunt predictions
variants.description: We forecast every Product Hunt launch day before votes are visible, then publish how we did. Free, no login. See today's predicted ranking, each launch's chance of a top-5 finish, and our full track record, misses included.

variants.name: PH Daily Forecast
variants.tagline: See where today's launches will land, free
variants.description: Launching soon or just curious? This free board ranks today's Product Hunt launches by predicted finish, using only what is public at 12:05am PT. It updates again at 3:45am, and yesterday's forecast is graded against the real result.

variants.name: UserSim Launch Simulator
variants.tagline: Paste your URL, see how your launch would land
variants.description: Paste a product URL before you launch. You get the questions and concerns Product Hunt users are most likely to raise, simulated reactions, and an expected rank band. Built on 81,000 real Product Hunt voter profiles. Free to try, no signup.

variants.name: UserSim Launch Simulator
variants.tagline: Rehearse your Product Hunt launch before launch day
variants.description: A dry run for your launch. Paste your page and see what real voter groups would ask, what would put them off, and roughly where you would finish. Fix the page first, launch second. Our predicted questions are checked daily against real launch comments.

variants.name: UserSim Launch Simulator
variants.tagline: Know the questions your launch will get, in advance
variants.description: Most launch-day comments are predictable. Paste a URL and get the top concerns and questions your page will draw from Product Hunt users, plus an expected rank band. In our live test the predicted questions beat a fixed list of common questions.

variants.name: UserSim Audience Panel
variants.tagline: A panel of 24 Product Hunt voter personas for your launch
variants.description: Each persona stands for 20 or more real Product Hunt voters with similar tastes. Show them your launch and read each group's reaction, concern and question. In a back-test on 276 past launches the panel predicted 63% of the themes real commenters raised.

variants.name: UserSim Audience Panel
variants.tagline: Hear from your launch audience before they exist
variants.description: We grouped 81,000 real Product Hunt voters by what they upvote, then built a panel that answers as those groups would. See who is drawn to your product, who is not, and what each group would say about it. Simulated, and labelled as such.

variants.name: UserSim Audience Panel
variants.tagline: Which Product Hunt voters will back you, and why
variants.description: See your launch through 24 voter groups built from real Product Hunt voting history. For each group: how strongly your kind of product pulls them, what they would ask, and what would put them off. Groups only; no individual users are shown.

variants.name: UserSim Launch Pack
variants.tagline: Pre-launch audit, launch-day read and post-mortem
variants.description: A paid package for founders launching on Product Hunt. Before: an audit of your page against the questions voters will ask. On the day: a forecast of where you will land, updated before votes show. After: a post-mortem against the real result.

variants.name: UserSim Launch Pack
variants.tagline: Everything we know about your launch, before and after
variants.description: For one launch you get three reports: what to fix on your page before launch, a launch-day forecast with our published accuracy, and an honest post-mortem of what happened and why. Built on real Product Hunt voting data, with every number sourced.

variants.name: UserSim Launch Pack
variants.tagline: Launch on Product Hunt with the data on your side
variants.description: A founder package built on 81,000 real voter profiles and a forecast we grade in public every day. You get a pre-launch page audit, a launch-day rank forecast and a post-mortem. No vote-getting, no growth tricks: insight only.

variants.name: UserSim API
variants.tagline: Launch forecasts and voter-group reactions, as an API
variants.description: Send a product URL or description and get back predicted questions and concerns, voter-group reactions and an expected rank band as JSON. The same models that power our public Product Hunt forecast, for agents and tools that help founders launch.

variants.name: UserSim API
variants.tagline: Give your agent a simulated launch audience
variants.description: An API for agents that build or market products. Ask how a launch page would land with real Product Hunt voter groups and get structured answers: likely questions, concerns and an expected rank band. Simulated output, labelled with measured accuracy.

variants.name: UserSim API
variants.tagline: Product Hunt audience simulation for developers
variants.description: One endpoint, JSON out. Predicted launch-day questions, concerns by voter group and an expected rank band for any product page. Built on 81,000 real Product Hunt voter profiles and a daily forecast we score in public.
